releases.name: v2.1.0
releases.body:
## [2.1.0] - 2026-11-08

A redesigned cluster page. The workspace is now an explorer, the provider
choice survives a Freelens restart, and the page keeps working in both host
themes. AgentBridge 2.1.0 requires Freelens 2.0.0 or later.

### Added

- A bridge strip at the top of the page that names the cluster, the selected
  provider, and its workspace path, with dashed connection wires that fill
  teal once the provider answers and the workspace exists.
- A workspace explorer: a list of the workspace's configuration files,
  capabilities, skills, and agents on the left, and the selected item in a
  full-height pane on the right. Files open in the host Monaco editor with
  autosave.
- A session bar that shows the selected provider's status, version, and
  workspace actions next to the one primary action, **Open session**.
- A `Ctrl`+`Enter` (`⌘`+`Enter` on macOS) shortcut that opens a session from
  anywhere on the page except an editor or text field.
- Provider marks for OpenCode, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, OpenAI Codex
  CLI, and Pi, drawn in `currentColor` beside every provider name.
- Capability progress in the explorer: **Built 4m ago** once the capability's
  artifact exists in the workspace, or **Not built yet** before it has run.
- Copy buttons for the workspace path, a capability's invocation command, and
  an artifact's path.
- First-visit, loading, and blocked states: an introduction when no provider is
  selected, skeleton rows while the CLI is checked, and an installation guide
  when it is missing.
- Rescan, Try again, and Check again controls for the workspace scan and the
  provider version probe.
- Per-cluster provider selections persisted in the main process under
  `userData/agentbridge-provider-selections.json` through two new IPC
  channels, so they survive a Freelens restart.

### Changed

- The cluster page is now a two-pane workspace explorer instead of a single
  column that stacked every editor and showed capabilities in a side rail.
- The provider picker is a segmented radio group with provider marks instead of
  a dropdown; the full provider name remains its tooltip and accessible name.
- The Reset confirmation now lists every file it restores, keeps instructions,
  skills, and agents untouched, and confirms when the reset completes.
- The file editor shows the full file path and an autosave status
  (Autosaves as you type, Saving…, Saved, Not saved), and writes a pending save
  immediately when another file, provider, or cluster is selected.
- Skills and agents moved from the collapsible Workspace artifacts panel into
  the explorer's own groups, newest first, with the artifact's details shown on
  selection.
- The two extension preferences (version probe timeout and editor command) now
  share one preferences block, and failed saves report **Not saved**.
- `Reveal workspace` is now **Reveal**, `Retry` is now **Check again** (probe)
  or **Try again** (scan), and `Reset` is now **Reset…**.
- The README and configuration guide describe the explorer, and the demos and
  screenshots were refreshed.

### Fixed

- The provider selection no longer disappears on every Freelens restart.
  Renderer `localStorage` does not persist in Freelens 2, so the choice is now
  stored in the main process instead.
- A provider file that fails to read is no longer replaced by an empty,
  editable buffer; the editor shows the read error instead.
- A pending debounced save is no longer dropped when switching files,
  providers, or clusters.
- Late provider-selection answers from a cluster the user has already left are
  discarded, and a selection made while the saved choice is still loading wins.
- Corrupt or invalid persisted selections are treated as no selection, and
  writes reject unknown providers and invalid cluster IDs.
- A failed workspace scan no longer reads as an authoritative zero count; it
  shows the error and a Try again action.
- Accessibility: decorative Material icons no longer pollute accessible names,
  the provider switcher uses native radio semantics, copy and scan buttons have
  labels, status and error regions are announced, focus rings are visible, and
  reduced-motion preferences are respected.
- Secondary actions now draw a visible border around the host's outlined
  `Button`, and code in preferences hints is readable in the light theme.

### Internal

- Updated tooling and dependencies: pnpm 12.18.0, Electron 44.10.1, Biome
  2.6.4, knip 6.41.0, and refreshed Trunk and mise versions.
- Biome now excludes Markdown, YAML, and SCSS, which Trunk already formats and
  which Biome 2.6 would rewrite destructively.
- The npm dedupe workflow no longer tries to commit an empty result when the
  automation branch already contains it.
- Added tests for the bridge strip, workspace explorer, file editor, page
  model, and the main-process provider-selection store.

[2.1.0]: https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-agentbridge-extension/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.0

## What's Changed
* Align the npm dedupe workflow with the example extension by @robertobandini in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-agentbridge-extension/pull/89
* Update dependency jdx/mise to v2026.11.4 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-agentbridge-extension/pull/87
* Update pnpm to v12.18.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-agentbridge-extension/pull/72
* Automated trunk upgrade cli upgraded 1.25.0 → 1.29.0, markdownlint 0.49.1 → 0.50.0 [skip ci] by @freelensbot in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-agentbridge-extension/pull/66
* Update Freelens dependencies by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-agentbridge-extension/pull/88
* Automated npm version v2.1.0 by @freelensbot in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-agentbridge-extension/pull/90


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-agentbridge-extension/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.0

releases.name: v2.0.0
releases.body:
The first release for Freelens 2.x, on the v2 extension API. It needs Freelens 2.0.0 or later; versions 1.x are for Freelens 1.x.

The port comes from #76 and #77, aligned with the Freelens 2.0.0 release in #85.

releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.body:
# What's new in 1.3.0
## Two new AI CLI providers — five in total

- Codex CLI — seeds AGENTS.md, .codex/config.toml and a build-cluster-map skill. It launches with the trust and network flags already set, so kubectl reaches your cluster on the first run with no manual setup.
- Pi — seeds AGENTS.md, .pi/settings.json and a kubectl guard extension. Pi ships no permission file of its own, so AgentBridge provides a real interceptor: read-only kubectl/helm/oc commands run freely, anything else asks you first.

## Bring your own model

AgentBridge seeds behavior and guardrails only — it never pins a model. Pick whichever model your CLI supports.

## Clearer editing and recovery

The built-in editor now highlights TOML and TypeScript, alongside the existing formats.
Reset restores the seeded guardrail and command files for the selected provider; the README now spells out exactly which files each provider's Reset touches, and what it leaves alone.
A broken Pi guard file stops Pi from starting — Reset gets you back to a working state.

## Better error messages

After installing an update, selecting a newly added provider could fail with a raw Unsupported AI CLI provider error. You now get a plain explanation that Freelens needs a restart, instead of a message with no obvious fix.
